summary: The main risks are compatibility at the serialization boundary, incomplete round-trip fidelity, and export/import paths bypassing existing lifecycle, tenancy, and optional-dependency contracts. The design should add explicit compatibility tests and shared negotiation/extraction boundaries before expanding the API surface.

suggestions.title: Keep the persisted dialect field out of legacy response serialization
suggestions.rationale: `FormSchema.model_dump()` includes default-valued fields, while `get_form()` returns that dump directly. Adding `dialect=json_schema` therefore changes existing GET responses, including schemas loaded from old `schema_json`; use a legacy response projection that omits only the new field when it has the default, and add golden byte-level tests for old persisted forms.

suggestions.title: Centralize dialect negotiation after authorization and before rendering
suggestions.rationale: `get_form()` and `get_schema()` currently perform different lifecycle sequences, while `handle_render()` has its own membership check. A new branch in only one handler can bypass `enforce_membership_unless_public`, `onBeforeOpen`, or `onSchemaLoaded`; implement one negotiated-render helper with explicit precedence and define whether A2UI receives schema overrides or rejects them.

suggestions.title: Define and enforce a real strict-round-trip fidelity boundary
suggestions.rationale: The current A2UI renderer does not emit several `FormSchema` values: section descriptions/dependencies, field descriptions, options-source metadata, disabled option state, and several field metadata values. Section identity is only present on field extensions, so empty sections cannot be reconstructed. Either emit canonical `parrot_*` metadata for the supported subset or make strict extraction return explicit warnings for every omitted value; do not claim identity beyond that tested projection.

suggestions.title: Test JSON-Schema round trips against every emitted extension
suggestions.rationale: `JsonSchemaRenderer` emits `x-section`, `x-subsection`, placeholders, read-only markers, dependencies, and labeled `x-options`, but `JsonSchemaExtractor` currently mainly consumes `enum`, `x-options-source`, and field-level dependency extensions. In particular, multi-select options are emitted under `items.enum` plus `x-options` and are not reconstructed as options. Add fixture-based round-trip tests covering nested sections, labels/disabled options, descriptions, defaults, and both dependency levels.

suggestions.title: Separate createSurface import detection from action detection
suggestions.rationale: `create_form()` currently checks for an LLM client before parsing the body and only accepts `prompt`; an A2UI import would incorrectly return 503 before reaching extraction. Existing A2UI request detection is designed for renderer-to-agent `action` envelopes, not agent-to-renderer `createSurface` envelopes. Add a distinct surface detector, validate with `deserialize()`/`validate_message()` and catalog rules, stamp the URL tenant rather than trusting imported metadata, and register with collision-safe identity semantics.

suggestions.title: Make A2UI extraction graph-safe and resource-bounded
suggestions.rationale: A2UI components are a flat ID-indexed graph, and the generic `Component` model permits catalog-specific extras. The extractor must reject or warn on duplicate IDs, missing child references, cycles, multiple roots, invalid bindings, and unsupported component properties rather than relying on Pydantic alone. Apply the same body/component-count/depth limits used for A2UI submissions before traversing untrusted imported surfaces.

suggestions.title: Do not build bulk export on the cache-only registry view
suggestions.rationale: `FormRegistry.list_forms()` and `list_tenants()` operate on in-memory buckets, while persisted rows are handled separately by `FormStorage.list_forms()`. A service that only wraps the registry will omit database-only forms and tenants not hydrated at startup; `PostgresFormStorage` also resolves a tenant schema from an explicit argument rather than enumerating all schemas. Make `export_tenant(tenant)` authoritative and explicit, or inject a tenant catalog/storage enumerator before offering `--all-tenants`; define `published_only` against version metadata as part of that contract.

suggestions.title: Avoid embedding full surfaces in ordinary list descriptors
suggestions.rationale: The current list handler merges lightweight memory and storage descriptors. Rendering an A2UI envelope for every entry makes `GET /forms?dialect=a2ui` an unbounded N-render operation and can produce very large responses. Prefer `include=surface` with pagination and a response-size cap, or return a surface URL/manifest from the list while reserving full envelopes for the export endpoint.

suggestions.title: Preserve explicit failure semantics when the A2UI extra is absent
suggestions.rationale: The existing renderer registry detects the optional package with `find_spec()` and simply omits the `a2ui` renderer, which is appropriate for the render dispatcher but insufficient for a persisted form whose effective dialect is A2UI or an explicit A2UI query. The new paths must distinguish unavailable capability from an unknown dialect and return the documented 415/501 without silently falling back to legacy output; all new service/extractor imports must remain lazy.

suggestions.title: Add lifecycle, authorization, and error-path tests for negotiated GETs
suggestions.rationale: The existing A2UI tests cover submit/validate envelopes, but not negotiated `get_form`/`get_schema` responses. Tests should prove precedence of query/header/persisted dialect, private-form membership enforcement, `onBeforeOpen` abort behavior, `onSchemaLoaded` behavior, missing-extra responses, legacy byte compatibility, and that lifecycle aborts still use the negotiated A2UI response shape where applicable.

suggestions.title: Treat the CLI as an optional integration with explicit dependency ownership
suggestions.rationale: The `parrot` executable and lazy command map belong to `ai-parrot`, while `parrot-formdesigner` does not currently declare a CLI dependency of its own. Registering a command in the core package creates a reverse optional integration that must fail cleanly when the satellite is absent; keep implementation in `parrot_formdesigner.cli`, add a lazy command plus install hint in `ai-parrot`, and document whether standalone formdesigner installations expose any CLI at all.
